# PiTTy v0.6.38

This release removes cold TypeScript/TSX compilation from the normal PiTTy launch path and makes existing profiled-subagent installs pick up the startup-handshake fix automatically.

## Faster startup

- Installers build PiTTy's local runtime once during install or upgrade.
- Normal launches prefer the built JavaScript entrypoints.
- Source fallback remains available for development checkouts.
- Built code resolves PiTTy's extension assets from the installation root.

## Subagent updates

- `pitty upgrade` refreshes an already-installed `git:github.com/mistrjirka/pi-subagent` runtime.
- It does not install the optional runtime when it was not already present.
- POSIX upgrades preserve the saved plugin mode, matching Windows.

PiTTy v0.6.37 already contains the 60-second Pi RPC tolerance and bounded diagnostic logs; pi-subagent v0.5.6 contains the startup-only 60-second child prompt handshake.
